Fit the GLMM-Oracle baseline (main effects + planted interactions)

Source: R/baselines.R
fit_glmm_oracle.Rd

Identical to fit_glmm_naive() except the planted DGP interactions are added as fixed-effect product terms. Represents the upper bound for a regression baseline assuming the analyst knows which channels co-modulate.

Usage

fit_glmm_oracle(df, config, planted_interactions)

Arguments

df

A data.frame or data.table panel.

config

A run_config() object.

planted_interactions

List of interaction_spec() objects (typically ground_truth$interactions).

Value

Same structure as fit_glmm_naive().
